name: Camping Wertacher Hof
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Wertacher Hof is situated in Oy-Mittelberg in the alpine foothills. Encircled by tranquil forests and mountains, the facility provides pitches and rental chalets alongside an authentic restaurant serving regional specialties. The area features scenic hiking trails in summer and prepared cross-country ski tracks in winter, making it ideal for families and nature enthusiasts.
